_comment: Sanitized golden vector: one REAL Bitcoin mainnet segwit transaction and its canonical txid. Public on-chain data only. Derived from a developer-only swap record by copying exactly two whitelisted fields; carries no WIF, no private key and no HTLC preimage (the claim tx was deliberately NOT used -- an HTLC claim reveals the preimage in its witness). Used by tests/test_mempool_adapters.py so the broadcaster's local txid derivation runs against real witness-bearing bytes on every clean checkout.
